subject: planner: notify skyline pruning of index statistics availability (#59110)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs first parent (planner-only). The functional change is confined to `compareCandidates` returning the winning path’s pseudo/missing-stats flag so `skylinePruning` can correctly set `idxMissingStats` and gate `preferRange` pruning; no correctness/semantics/data-consistency/concurrency/privilege issues found. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and did not find an indication that this change introduced a Blocker/High issue that required a follow-up fix.
